No, continuous intravenous infusion of low-concentration epinephrine does not impair uterine blood flow in pregnant ewes. The available data suggest that such infusions are safe and do not affect maternal hemodynamics or uterine blood flow.

More specifically, a study on pregnant ewes found no significant alteration in both maternal hemodynamic parameters and uterine blood flow when low-concentration epinephrine was continuously infused during the procedure. These results indicate that continuous intravenous infusion of epinephrine in local anesthetic solutions is safe for this population if proper precautions are taken, such as ensuring the epidural catheter does not enter a blood vessel during the infusion.
